text: Adopt <namespace>/log/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl as the canonical log path across all machines; do not create a YYYY/ subdirectory layer.
Keep log entries lightweight - one line per tag - so appending is fast and reading is scannable.
The configured namespace in the primary repo is writable; all reference roots stay read-only.
Prefer dense entry style in log entries to minimise file churn.
Decide whether to keep or delete the old memory/2026/2026-04-13.md style path after migration is confirmed.
